title: Agents Prompt People: Using Agents for Long-Horizon Financial Work
author: Richard MacManus
description: Arca's head of AI discusses persistent memory, the benefits of a custom harness, and agentic workflows that span days.
summary: At AI Engineer New York this month, we sat down with Aman Singh , the lead AI Engineer at Arca , an “AI-native” company providing wealth management services. We discovered that while agents do most of the background work in the firm, there are guardrails in place to ensure that human advisors are making the final decisions.
takeaways: All of this is being tracked by our memory systems that our agents contribute to.” Arca uses models from frontier labs like Anthropic and OpenAI, with Claude its primary model provider.
“And they take the decision making off the agent's hands.” In other words, there are certain tools and tasks the agent can execute by itself — but not ones that involve risk to the client.
